title: Hangover-Cure Vietnamese Kale Cha Gio
description: A sour and crumbly Vietnamese dish featuring kale that is perfect for a hangover cure. Slow-cooked to preserve low-carb friendly nutrients.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.notes: curly kale leaves, stems removed and discarded

ingredients.name: Tamarind paste
ingredients.notes: or substitute with 2 tablespoons of freshly squeezed lime juice and 1 teaspoon of honey

ingredients.name: Fermented fish sauce
ingredients.notes: or substitute with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: or substitute with chopped peanuts or cashews

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat, low-carb and rich in nutrients

instructions: Combine tamarind paste, fermented fish sauce, grated ginger, black pepper, and coconut milk in a blender or food processor to make the sauce.
Stir-fry kale leaves in a pan with 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds until wilted and slightly caramelized.
In a separate pot, heat the beef broth over low heat, and then stir in cornstarch to thicken.
Steam the kale mixture in the beef broth for 15-20 minutes, or until the kale is fully cooked.
Transfer the kale mixture to a serving dish, and spoon the sauce over the top.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
